name: block-section-head
use: The heading of a section with an anchor: the blocks after it belong to the section.
avoid: Before block-cards, block-flow or block-showcase-frame (they print the same head themselves); two heads in a row.
props: { kind: 'block-section-head'; id: string; title: string; badge?: string }

cases.title: A section that groups the paragraphs after it
cases.why: The anchor and the heading make the section findable from a table of contents.

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-section-head. In a page: { "kind": "block-section-head", "id": "roles", "title": "Roles" }.
